description: NHFLOW hydrostatic semi-implicit with density: lock exchange in a 4 km x 10 m channel (400 x 20 sigma layers), salinity 0 | 10 psu at x = 2 km (A 602), no friction and no diffusion. The fronts run at 0.35 m/s = 0.81 of 1/2 sqrt(g' H) with the default time step (N 47 0.4); 0.389 m/s with N 47 0.1 and 0.402 m/s (0.93) with N 47 0.025.
covers: baroclinic pressure gradient at a front, the split tracer step with TVD fronts, tracer gauges
